summary: Geometry, budget, texture size and rig pass, but 5 concept-colour assertions fail; partly the clustering method, partly a real shift (bone greyer and darker, harness near-black).

findings.observation: The concept's pale bone #CCB790 (29%) merged into #B6A281; the bone renders greyish olive-tan, darker and less yellow than the concept.
The maroon strap #613430 fell to 1.6%; the harness renders near-black brown rather than red-brown, possibly closer to the brief's Saddle Leather.
Peat-brown joint stains faint; belt buckle a small dark block.

escalation_reason: All 5 failures are colour assertions, partly misleading; 4 failed identically at 256 px. The fix is a clean-stage colour change or the user accepting the colours.
questions_answered: All parts present; bone darker/greyer, straps near-black.
